name: Skate bag (triangular)
description: Triangular skate bag for one pair (~40 long x 34 high at the heel x 22 wide; the skates inside are an L, so the side is a right-ish triangle), standing on its bottom. flip = heel end at +x.

source.notes: Sizes: Decathlon Fit 26 L (45 x 26 x 35), Decathlon 500 (40 x 20 x 35), Graf (40 x 24 x 36).
